settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: A small allowlist of tuning knobs that otherwise only live in the server's .env file. API keys and database credentials aren't here on purpose - they stay .env-only and require a restart.

language.label: Language
language.description: Switch the dashboard's display language for this browser.

descriptions.LLM_PROVIDER: Which backend every AI feature (article analysis, Intelligence Copilot, document splitting) talks to. Switching to a hosted provider sends uploaded document text to it, and only works if that provider's API key is already set in the server's .env.
descriptions.COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS_LLM_PROVIDER: Overrides the provider for just competitor-study document splitting, competitor naming, and finding generation. Same off-machine caveat as the LLM provider above.
descriptions.ANALYSIS_CONCURRENCY: How many articles one analysis run analyzes in parallel.
descriptions.COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS_CONCURRENCY: How many competitors' finding generation runs in parallel during one competitor analysis.
descriptions.SENTIMENT_CLASSIFIER_PROVIDER: Where the sentiment stage's model runs: in-process, or Hugging Face's hosted Inference API.
descriptions.SENTIMENT_CLASSIFIER_MODEL: Hugging Face model id the sentiment stage loads (only used when the provider above is "local").
descriptions.SENTIMENT_CLASSIFIER_DEVICE: Device the local sentiment model runs on: "cpu", "cuda"/"cuda:0", etc.
descriptions.SENTIMENT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD: Minimum classifier confidence to trust a non-neutral sentiment label; below this, sentiment falls back to neutral.
descriptions.CLASSIFICATION_PROVIDER: Where the classification stage's model runs: in-process, or Hugging Face's hosted Inference API.
descriptions.REGION_DETECTION_LLM_FALLBACK: "On" skips the rule-based region scan entirely and asks the configured LLM provider directly instead, at the cost of one extra per-article round trip.
descriptions.LLM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: How long a single LLM call waits before giving up, for any call that doesn't set its own longer budget. Raise this before lowering concurrency if a slow/CPU-only local model legitimately needs longer.
descriptions.BUSINESS_PROFILE_LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: LLM timeout budget for deriving a competitor study's business profile.
descriptions.COMPETITOR_FINDING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: LLM timeout budget for competitor finding generation - the heaviest competitor-analysis call.
descriptions.ARTICLE_RELEVANCE_SCREENING_MODE: "Off" skips relevance screening entirely; "observe" records a score without excluding anything; "enforce" actually excludes articles scoring below the exclude threshold.
descriptions.ARTICLE_RELEVANCE_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD: Cosine-similarity score at or above which an article is confidently in-scope. Not a probability - tune it empirically. Must stay at or above the exclude threshold below.
descriptions.ARTICLE_RELEVANCE_EXCLUDE_THRESHOLD: Cosine-similarity score at or below which an article is excluded when the mode above is "enforce". Must stay at or below the accept threshold above.
descriptions.EVIDENCE_CLAIM_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD: Legacy compatibility knob: current Evidence rules don't use embedding similarity to merge assertions, so this has no effect unless an older ruleset reads it.
